Explain why the dish works in one or two sentences. Replace every placeholder
and set actual creation/modification dates before saving a real recipe.
Add source information only when known, never assume missing attribution
means original content.
This repository is public, even for drafts. Do not include private schedules
or personal notes. External works belong in the link-only source library.

## Ingredients

- Exact amount and ingredient, with preparation state

## Instructions

1. **Technique:** Give a concrete action with equipment, heat, time, and
   doneness cues. Match the actual ingredients.

## Notes

- **Substitution:** Explain a practical alternative and its trade-offs.
- **Budget:** Explain a lower-cost choice when useful.
- **Food safety:** Add appropriate handling and doneness guidance.

## Make-Ahead and Storage

- **Refrigerate:** Specify container and safe duration.
- **Freeze:** Specify method/duration or explain why freezing is unsuitable.
- **Reheat:** Specify a safe method and temperature where applicable.
